notes.title: An Apology, Updates, & Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hello all Purrtrollers!

I appreciate all of the people who took the time to play my game. I never expected it to reach more than a handful of people but here it is with over 100 reviews. It feels so crazy reaching this point!

Many people have felt offended by the dark humor in my game and I'm sorry to have caused that. I thought my cartoon-ish depictions would not be offensive but obviously I was wrong. Many people have felt that I was trolling or it was done intentionally to aggravate people but it's not the case. I've taken the effort to remove all of those drawings and replaced them with more wholesome depictions. I hope people can take the time to give my game a second chance.

When it comes to the quality of the game I'm still very new to game development and did the best I knew how to. I realized I had used low quality export settings and now that I have fixed them the quality of the line art should be much better. I learned how to create boundaries for the game camera so it should no longer be able to float off the canvas. Many people have offered good suggestions on how I can improve this game and I will slowly take the time to implement them. I work full-time and go to college full-time so updates will be slow to happen. I would like to make more levels in the future so I plan on learning how to make the game better.

Thank you for your time and hopefully we can build a better relationship together as people who love this genre. :)
